reviewNotes: iPhone Use is the companion remote for iphone-use, open-source software (https://github.com/leeguooooo/iphone-use) that runs on the user's own Mac and drives an iPhone connected to it. The app shows that phone's screen and sends taps, swipes and text to it. A real connection needs the user's Mac running the iphone-use daemon, so for review please use the built-in demo: on the first screen tap "Try the demo" (Chinese UI: "试用演示"). The demo plays screens recorded from a real iPhone; the places outlined in blue can be tapped (AirDrop, Picture in Picture, and the back button), and swiping right from the left edge goes back. No account or login is needed. The app collects no data and contacts no server other than the user's own Mac.

en-US.name: iPhone Use
en-US.subtitle: Remote for an AI-driven iPhone
en-US.promotionalText: See and control the iPhone your Mac's iphone-use drives: live screen, taps, swipes and typing. Try the built-in demo first, no Mac needed.
en-US.description:
iPhone Use is the remote for iphone-use, the open-source tool that lets AI agents and scripts operate a real iPhone from a Mac.

When an agent is working on a phone, open iPhone Use to watch what it does, take over with your own taps and swipes, type text into the phone, and hand it back.

• Live screen from the phone your Mac drives
• Tap, long press, swipe and drag, mapped onto the phone's screen
• Type text in any language
• Hand the phone back to its holder in one tap
• Pair by scanning a QR code on your Mac, no typing
• Built-in demo with recorded screens, to see how it works before setting anything up

How it works: install iphone-use on your Mac (one command, see the website), connect the iPhone it drives, then scan the code from the iphone-use page. This app talks only to that Mac on your network.

Privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking. The app collects nothing.
en-US.whatsNew: Adds a Speed / Quality switch for the live picture. Quality shows the phone at full resolution and up to about 50 fps; Speed keeps bandwidth low.

zh-Hans.name: iPhone Use
zh-Hans.subtitle: AI 操作 iPhone 的遥控器
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 查看并接管 Mac 上 iphone-use 正在操作的那台 iPhone：实时画面、点按、滑动、输入文字。没有 Mac 也能先试用内置演示。
zh-Hans.description:
iPhone Use 是 iphone-use 的遥控器。iphone-use 是一个开源工具，让 AI agent 和脚本在 Mac 上操作一台真实的 iPhone。

agent 在手机上干活时，打开 iPhone Use 就能看到它在做什么，随时用自己的手指接管、往手机里输入文字，用完再交还。

• 实时查看 Mac 正在操作的那台手机
• 点按、长按、滑动、拖动，准确对应到手机屏幕
• 输入任意语言的文字
• 一键把手机交还给持有人
• 在 Mac 上扫码配对，不用输地址和密码
• 内置演示：播放录好的画面，装好之前先看看怎么用

使用方式：在 Mac 上安装 iphone-use（一条命令，见项目主页），接上它要操作的 iPhone，再扫 iphone-use 页面上的二维码。App 只和你网络里的那台 Mac 通信。

隐私：不需要账号，没有统计，不追踪，不收集任何数据。
